RESEARCHERS · MAKERS · CURIOUS MINDS

Learn With Hemp.

Bring a question, a research focus or an idea for a small group. We are developing focused sessions around natural materials and everyday uses of hemp.

Natural building

Discuss a materials demonstration or introduction to hempcrete and finishes, with scope and facilitation agreed in advance.

Farm to material

Future seasonal sessions may follow cultivation and processing as the on-site patch develops. These activities are not currently guaranteed.

Make & discover

Register interest in proposed hemp-soap or hemp-food sessions. Each session will be announced only once its facilitator, materials and arrangements are confirmed.

No fixed workshop calendar is open yet. Dates, facilitator, group size, materials, fees and inclusions must be confirmed before payment. Research visits require an agreed scope; group sessions are planned around the quiet of the house and village.

A DAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Less to do.
More to feel.

Bring your own practice.
Let quiet be part of the plan.

MORNINGS · BREATHE

Begin softly.

Make space for gentle movement, meditation or a few moments of stillness. Ask about a suitable practice space for your dates.

AFTERNOONS · CREATE

Follow your own rhythm.

Read, write, or discuss a little unamplified music with the hosts. Keep the volume gentle and respect the village’s quiet.

Room arrangements and equipment vary. Please confirm any yoga, music or workspace requirements before booking.
